title: Dataverse Connection Config
description: Schema for validating the connections JSON files used by the Dataverse refresh pipeline

URL.description: Dataverse org URL. Must be HTTPS and a valid dynamics.com CRM endpoint.

AKV.description: Azure Key Vault name (not the full URI, just the vault name).

Username.description: Service account UPN used to authenticate to Dataverse.

SecretName.description: The KEY NAME of the secret in Key Vault — not the password value itself. Key Vault secret names allow only alphanumeric characters and hyphens.
